candidate_ideas.statement: For ordered-to-unordered distinct-support incidence spaces, the compatible torsors should be I→I^{red-supp} and, after reducing both sides, I_red→(I^{red-supp})_red.

Faithfully flat descent of reducedness, tested after constant base change to Spec(k[ε]/(ε²)), should rule out a finite étale torsor from I_red to a nonreduced I^{red-supp} whenever the distinct-support incidence is nonempty.

With a compatibly reduced ordering construction, the ordered reduced residual CE evaluation-rank-drop locus should have unordered model equal to the distinct-support open of the residual linear system of L.

established_facts.evidence: SRC-0004, Lemma 10.6 gives deg(W_f|_C)=2(2g−2+4·2)−4f=4g+12−4f under the γ^*O_P(−f) convention.
established_facts.statement: Under the convention W_f=(O_{P(E^∨)}(2)⊗γ^*O_P(−f))|_C, one has deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12−4f. For g=6, deg(W_5)=16, deg(W_4)=20, and deg(W_5⊗ω_C^{−1})=6.

established_facts.evidence: Using deg(ω_C)=10, deg(W_4)=20, and deg(W_5)=16 gives 10−20+6=−4 and 10−16+6=0.
established_facts.statement: For every effective degree-six divisor Γ on a smooth genus-six curve, deg(ω_C⊗W_4^∨(Γ))=−4 and deg(ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))=0.

established_facts.evidence: The line bundle has degree −4, and a negative-degree line bundle on a smooth proper connected curve has no nonzero global section.
established_facts.statement: For every effective degree-six divisor Γ on a smooth genus-six curve, H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_4^∨(Γ))=0.

established_facts.evidence: The bundle ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ) has degree zero. A degree-zero line bundle on a smooth projective connected curve has a nonzero section exactly when it is trivial; rearranging the resulting isomorphism gives the stated condition.
established_facts.statement: For every effective degree-six divisor Γ on a smooth genus-six curve, H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))≠0 if and only if O_C(Γ)≅W_5⊗ω_C^{−1}.

established_facts.evidence: The obstruction space is the direct sum of the f=4 and f=5 spaces. The first vanishes and the second is nonzero exactly under the Abel–Jacobi condition. Equality of geometric points for locally finite-type substacks over a field determines equality of their absolute reductions.
established_facts.statement: On geometric fibres with W≅W_4⊕W_5, the residual CE obstruction is nonzero at Γ if and only if O_C(Γ)≅L:=W_5⊗ω_C^{−1}; consequently (Z_ev)_red=I_red as reduced closed substacks of Conf_6(C/B).
On every smooth genus-six geometric fibre, χ(L)=1 and h^0(L)≥1, so the full Abel–Jacobi fibre of L in Sym^6 is nonempty.

established_facts.evidence: It is the complement of the finite closed image of the big diagonal. Fibrewise Sym^6(C) is irreducible, the distinct-support locus is nonempty, and nonreduced divisors such as 6p lie in its complement.
established_facts.statement: The locus of degree-six effective divisors with six pairwise-distinct support points is open and not closed in each relative effective-divisor fibre.

established_facts.evidence: S_6 acts freely by permuting labels, and the quotient of ordered distinct points by this finite free action is the corresponding unordered distinct-support divisor space.
established_facts.statement: Before applying reduction to only one side, ordering the six points over the distinct-support locus defines a finite étale S_6-torsor on the stack of pairwise-distinct sections.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The superscript red-supp imposes distinct support but does not remove nilpotents from the target. A finite étale torsor is faithfully flat, and reducedness descends under faithfully flat morphisms, so its reduced source would force the target to be reduced. For a nonempty constant family over Spec(k[ε]/(ε²)), the target retains the base nilpotent while I_red factors through the reduced base; the map is not flat.
invalid_steps.statement: The map I_red→I^{red-supp}, with only the source reduced, is always a finite étale S_6-torsor.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Equality after reduction does not repair the mismatch between a reduced source and a potentially nonreduced target. The ordering construction must remain unreduced on both sides or reduce both sides compatibly.
invalid_steps.statement: The ordered reduced model is a finite étale S_6-cover of the unreduced distinct-support Abel–Jacobi incidence via I_red→I^{red-supp}.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: Scheme-theoretic equality, including nilpotents and multiplicities, between the CE determinantal or Fitting ideal of Z_ev and the Abel–Jacobi ideal of I.
Fibrewise nonemptiness and denseness of the distinct-support incidence on every geometric fibre; Riemann–Roch establishes only nonemptiness of the full Sym^6 fibre.
Family-level construction and descent of W_5, L, and W≅W_4⊕W_5 when the CE relations bundle does not split globally, including relative Picard twists of O_P(−f).
A complete proof of the compatible ordering torsor I→I^{red-supp} or I_red→(I^{red-supp})_red over the intended stack.
The h^0-stratification of |L|, its components and dimensions, stabilizers, and maps to tetragonal moduli and M_{6,6}.
The Tate type of any contribution supported on Z to W_{−16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) and its assembly into the exact target.
